name: Harumi
source:
An outgoing girl who transfers to your school midsemester, Harumi immediately draws your attention. The two of you quickly hit it off, bringing you closer and closer together…

But why did she transfer ? Why is she keen to try new things?

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1506420569855643652?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
